# ADDI

> > ADDI is EHU's institutional digital repository for preserving, sharing, and providing open access to research, academic collections, and scholarly works.

ADDI (Archivo Digital de la Universidad del País Vasco) serves as the official digital repository for the University of the Basque Country (EHU), housing research publications, datasets, digitalized cultural heritage, teaching materials, and institutional archives. The repository supports open access principles and provides comprehensive access to academic and research outputs across multiple disciplines.

## Core Collections

- [ADDI Home](https://addi.ehu.es): ADDI institutional digital repository for EHU research and academic collections
- [Research Publications](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/91): Research publications, theses, and working papers from EHU institutions
- [Datasets](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/63127): Academic datasets collection for research data sharing and machine learning
- [Digitalized Collections](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/2565): Digitalized cultural heritage and academic collections from EHU libraries
- [Teaching Materials](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/1): Teaching materials and educational resources from EHU departments
- [Social Impact Research](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/77683): Social impact research and institutional archive collections

## Browse & Discover

- [Recently Added](https://addi.ehu.es/recent-submissions): Recently submitted research articles and academic papers to ADDI
- [Browse by Issue Date](https://addi.ehu.es/browse): Browse ADDI publications and scholarly articles by date

## Featured Research

- [IoT Security and Privacy SLA Composition](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/78646): IoT security and privacy SLA research by Ríos Velasco et al.
- [Solid-State Battery Technology Development](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/78645): Doctoral thesis on solid-state battery technology and polymer electrolytes
- [Weibull Parameters in Composite Materials](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/78644): Research on Weibull parameters and fiber-reinforced composite materials
- [Adipogenesis Regulation Research](https://addi.ehu.es/handle/10810/78643): Molecular biology research on adipogenesis regulation and lipid metabolism
